# Chitinid
An industrious hymenoptera species, the Chitinid are strong and diligent. Thanks to evolution, they have grown an acute resistance to radiation, but not without its side effects.
## Background
Humans are notorious for bringing things where they do not belong when traveling.
Your kind evolved when insects from Earth were left behind in their wake; whether that be by accident or not.
Your kind were a new and invasive species, overtaking the planet you were left on and evolving rapidly due to your planet’s lush and plentiful environment. Your kind were capable of expanding rapidly and creating colonies beneath the ground that stretched for miles. And when your kind were exposed to the harsh, irradiated environments within the planet WASP-025a, you did not die. No, instead, you mutated. Your species adapted to withstand the radiation that should have destroyed your kind’s DNA, to withstand the storms of glass shards that should have pierced straight through you.
You developed a quick mind and even quicker reflexes, as even your body evolved to further expand through the use of thumbs and bipedalism. Your work ethic was intense; something many corporations knew they could use to their advantage.
Maybe your colony was seized by corporate officials and hired you to work on their ships… or perhaps you, like many others before you, snuck on in search of tools but found something greater.
## Diet
- Can eat raw meat.
## Benefits
- Takes [color=#1e90ff]80% less Radiation damage, and 10% less Slash, Blunt and Piercing damage.[/color] - Their bodies [color=#1e90ff]naturally recover from light radiation damage up to a point[/color]; once they accumulate enough radiation, they must purge it from their systems in the form of a small rock [color=#ff0f0f]WARNING: The Chitzite they expel is slightly radioactive [/color]. - They possess a bio light.
## Drawbacks
- They take [color=#FFA500]15% more Shock damage[/color] due to their biology. - Thanks to their overactive systems they get [color=#FFA500]hungry 33% faster.[/color] - The cold does not agree with their biology and makes their [color=#FFA500]movement sluggish the colder it gets[/color]. The cold also harms them more than others, causing them to take [color=#FFA500]25% more damage from it. [/color][/color] - Bug Blood cannot be synthesized from iron. - Chitinid exoskeletons cannot be pierced by syringes and hyposprays.
